أتضادد (form VI)
# أَتَضَادَدُ (ʔataḍādadu) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.da.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَضَادَدَ (taḍādada)
# أَتَضَادَدَ (ʔataḍādada) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.da.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَضَادَدَ (taḍādada)
# أَتَضَادَدْ (ʔataḍādad) /ʔa.ta.dˤaː.dad/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَضَادَدَ (taḍādada)
